name: Sunken Treasure
summary: Now that they are full-fledged Blackwater Raiders, Professor Phizzlethorpe and Doctor Draxlegauge are to help Mr. O'Breen find the lost elven treasure. To search the dark sea for the gems, the professor needs your protection while he charges a pair of goggles at an enchanted stone in a cave.

sections.title: Charging the Goggles
sections.body: The gems are next to impossible to find in the dark sea without help, so Doctor Draxlegauge has built goggles for the search. They need charging with power from the enchanted stone, in a cave a short way uphill. The cave is cursed, though: those who draw near are ambushed. Professor Phizzlethorpe asks you to defend him while he draws the stone's energy into the goggles.

faq.answer: Professor Phizzlethorpe asks you to defend him as he goes to the cave and back, charging the doctor's goggles at the enchanted stone.

faq.q: Why do the goggles need to be charged?
faq.answer: Doctor Draxlegauge built them to help find the lost gems in the dark sea. To work, they must first be charged with the stone's power.

faq.q: Why does the professor need an escort?
faq.answer: The cave is cursed, and when they get close they are ambushed. He needs you to defend him while he channels the stone's energy.

faq.q: Who are the professor and the doctor working for?
faq.answer: The professor says they are now full-fledged Blackwater Raiders, so helping Mr. O'Breen find the lost elven treasure falls to them.
